mergedParams.userDescription: Pixel sorting and block displacement. internal effects for text, video, images

prompts.prompt: Create an internal effect preset called 'PixelSortGlitch' that simulates digital pixel sorting artifacts through a series of horizontal displacement animations. The effect should create a glitch aesthetic by animating translateX with randomized stepped values, creating horizontal 'tears' in the content. Use generic AnimationRange effects with 8-12 keyframes that create sudden jumps in translateX position (ranging from -20px to +20px), combined with brief opacity flickers (dropping to 0.7-0.9) at random intervals. Include a subtle RGB color shift effect using CSS filters (hue-rotate animating between -5deg and 5deg). The effect should accept parameters for intensity (controls displacement range), glitchFrequency (number of displacement keyframes), and colorShift (boolean to enable/disable hue rotation). Use ease-out easing for the displacements to create a 'snapping' feel, and linear easing for opacity changes. The effect targets components via targetIds array passed through params.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic (AnimationRange[]). Return structure: { effects: [{ type: 'generic', mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, start: params.start || 0, duration: params.duration || 1000, ranges: { translateX: AnimationRange[], opacity: AnimationRange[], filter: AnimationRange[] } }] }. Input schema: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), intensity: z.number().min(0).max(100).default(50), glitchFrequency: z.number().min(4).max(20).default(8), colorShift: z.boolean().default(true), duration: z.number().optional(), start: z.number().optional() }). PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects', dependencies: { presets: [] } }. AnimationRange format: translateX ranges with prog values distributed across 0-1, val alternating between negative and positive pixel values based on intensity param.

prompts.prompt: Build an internal waveform effect preset named 'BlockDisplaceBeat' that creates audio-reactive block displacement synchronized to bass frequencies. The effect should make elements appear to 'break apart' into blocks that displace on strong beats. Implement using waveform effect type with 'translate' mode that responds to bass frequencies (20-250Hz). Configure high sensitivity (0.8) with a threshold of 0.3 to trigger only on prominent beats. The displacement should alternate between translateX and translateY based on beat count, creating a chaotic scatter effect. Add a secondary waveform 'scale' effect that pulses elements from 1.0 to 1.15 on the same bass hits. Parameters should include displacementRange (max pixels to displace), axisBehavior ('alternate' | 'horizontal' | 'vertical' | 'both'), and bassBoost (multiplier for bass sensitivity). The effect should feel like the content is being shattered and reassembled in real-time with the music.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Waveform (audio-reactive). Return structure: { effects: [{ type: 'waveform', mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, effectType: 'translate', audioProperty: 'bass', sensitivity: params.bassBoost * 0.8, threshold: 0.3, minValue: -params.displacementRange, maxValue: params.displacementRange, axis: params.axisBehavior }, { type: 'waveform', mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, effectType: 'scale', audioProperty: 'bass', sensitivity: params.bassBoost * 0.6, threshold: 0.3, minValue: 1.0, maxValue: 1.15 }] }. Input schema: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), displacementRange: z.number().min(10).max(200).default(50), axisBehavior: z.enum(['alternate', 'horizontal', 'vertical', 'both']).default('alternate'), bassBoost: z.number().min(0.5).max(2).default(1) }). PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects', dependencies: { presets: [] } }.

prompts.prompt: Design an internal effect preset called 'PixelStairStep' that creates a staggered pixel sorting effect where content appears to shift in rectangular blocks with different timing offsets. The effect should use generic AnimationRange to create a 'staircase' displacement pattern. Divide the animation into 5 distinct phases, each affecting a different 'layer' of the pixel sort. Phase 1 animates translateX from 0 to 30px (prog 0-0.2), Phase 2 adds translateY from 0 to -20px (prog 0.15-0.35), Phase 3 introduces skewX from 0deg to 8deg (prog 0.3-0.5), Phase 4 reverses translateX back through -40px (prog 0.45-0.75), and Phase 5 normalizes all values back to 0 (prog 0.7-1.0). Include a brightness filter that pulses from 100% to 130% during displacement peaks. Accept parameters for blockSize (affects displacement distances), skewIntensity, and reverseTiming (boolean to reverse the entire sequence). Use spring easing for the skew effect and ease-in-out for translations.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic (AnimationRange[]). Return structure: { effects: [{ type: 'generic', mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, start: params.start || 0, duration: params.duration || 1500, easing: 'ease-in-out', ranges: { translateX: [{key:'translateX',val:0,prog:0}, {key:'translateX',val:params.blockSize*0.3,prog:0.2}, {key:'translateX',val:params.blockSize*0.3,prog:0.45}, {key:'translateX',val:-params.blockSize*0.4,prog:0.75}, {key:'translateX',val:0,prog:1}], translateY: [{key:'translateY',val:0,prog:0}, {key:'translateY',val:0,prog:0.15}, {key:'translateY',val:-params.blockSize*0.2,prog:0.35}, {key:'translateY',val:-params.blockSize*0.2,prog:0.7}, {key:'translateY',val:0,prog:1}], skewX: [{key:'skewX',val:'0deg',prog:0}, {key:'skewX',val:'0deg',prog:0.3}, {key:'skewX',val:`${params.skewIntensity}deg`,prog:0.5}, {key:'skewX',val:'0deg',prog:1}], filter: [{key:'filter',val:'brightness(100%)',prog:0}, {key:'filter',val:'brightness(130%)',prog:0.25}, {key:'filter',val:'brightness(100%)',prog:0.5}, {key:'filter',val:'brightness(120%)',prog:0.6}, {key:'filter',val:'brightness(100%)',prog:1}] } }] }. Input schema: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), blockSize: z.number().min(10).max(200).default(100), skewIntensity: z.number().min(0).max(15).default(8), reverseTiming: z.boolean().default(false), duration: z.number().optional(), start: z.number().optional() }). PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' }.

prompts.prompt: Create an internal combined effect preset named 'DataMoshDisplace' that simulates video datamoshing artifacts through multiple layered displacement effects. Combine three distinct effect types: 1) A primary generic effect that creates 'frame ghosting' by animating opacity in stepped intervals (1.0, 0.3, 0.8, 0.2, 1.0) with harsh linear transitions, 2) A secondary generic effect for 'macroblock displacement' using transform: translate3d() with random X/Y values that jump between positions rather than smoothly transitioning, and 3) A tertiary filter effect that cycles through contrast(150%) saturate(0%) brightness(120%) to simulate color channel corruption. The displacement positions should be calculated using a pseudo-random pattern based on the effect index. Parameters include corruptionLevel (affects displacement range and opacity drops), blockCount (number of displacement jumps), and colorGlitch (enables/disables the filter effect). Each effect should have slightly offset timing to create temporal artifacts.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Combined (multiple generic effects). Return structure: { effects: [{ type: 'generic', mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, start: 0, duration: params.duration, ranges: { opacity: generateSteppedOpacity(params.corruptionLevel) } }, { type: 'generic', mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, start: 50, duration: params.duration - 50, ranges: { transform: generateBlockDisplacement(params.blockCount, params.corruptionLevel) } }, { type: 'generic', mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, start: 25, duration: params.duration - 25, ranges: { filter: params.colorGlitch ? generateColorCorruption() : [] } }] }. Input schema: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), corruptionLevel: z.number().min(0).max(100).default(60), blockCount: z.number().min(3).max(12).default(6), colorGlitch: z.boolean().default(true), duration: z.number().min(500).max(3000).default(1200) }). Helper functions generate AnimationRange arrays with stepped/jumped values. PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' }.

prompts.prompt: Develop an internal waveform effect preset called 'FrequencySort' that creates pixel sorting effects driven by audio frequency analysis across different bands. The effect should use multiple waveform effects targeting different frequency ranges: bass (20-250Hz) controls horizontal displacement, mids (250-4000Hz) control vertical displacement, and treble (4000-20000Hz) controls rotation. Each frequency band should have different sensitivity levels - bass at 0.7, mids at 0.5, treble at 0.9. The displacement values should create a 'sorting' effect where content appears to separate into frequency-responsive layers. Add a complementary blur effect that intensifies (0 to 4px) when overall waveform amplitude exceeds 0.6. Parameters include frequencyIsolation (adjusts band sensitivity), maxDisplacement (caps movement range), and rotationEnabled (toggles treble-driven rotation). The combined effect should make content appear to deconstruct based on the audio's frequency content.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Waveform (multi-band audio-reactive). Return structure: { effects: [{ type: 'waveform', mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, effectType: 'translate', audioProperty: 'bass', sensitivity: 0.7 * params.frequencyIsolation, axis: 'x', minValue: -params.maxDisplacement, maxValue: params.maxDisplacement }, { type: 'waveform', mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, effectType: 'translate', audioProperty: 'mid', sensitivity: 0.5 * params.frequencyIsolation, axis: 'y', minValue: -params.maxDisplacement * 0.7, maxValue: params.maxDisplacement * 0.7 }, params.rotationEnabled && { type: 'waveform', mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, effectType: 'rotate', audioProperty: 'treble', sensitivity: 0.9 * params.frequencyIsolation, minValue: -15, maxValue: 15 }, { type: 'waveform', mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, effectType: 'blur', audioProperty: 'waveform', sensitivity: 0.6, threshold: 0.6, minValue: 0, maxValue: 4 }].filter(Boolean) }. Input schema: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), frequencyIsolation: z.number().min(0.1).max(2).default(1), maxDisplacement: z.number().min(10).max(100).default(40), rotationEnabled: z.boolean().default(true) }). PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' }.

prompts.prompt: Build an internal effect preset named 'ChromaticPixelShift' that creates RGB channel separation with pixel-sorted displacement patterns. The effect should animate three separate color channels using CSS filters and transforms to simulate analog video color bleeding. Use generic AnimationRange to create: 1) A red channel shift that moves translateX in a sine wave pattern (0px to 15px back to -10px to 0px), 2) A green channel that remains mostly stable but flickers opacity (1.0 to 0.95) at specific points, 3) A blue channel that combines translateY displacement (-5px to 8px) with slight rotation (-2deg to 2deg). Apply these through filter: drop-shadow() for each channel with respective colors. Include additional effects for scan lines using repeating linear-gradient in the background. Parameters should control channelSeparation (distance of RGB splits), glitchIntensity (amplitude of displacements), and scanlineOpacity. The effect should create a retro CRT monitor aesthetic with modern glitch art sensibilities.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic (AnimationRange[]). Return structure: { effects: [{ type: 'generic', mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, start: 0, duration: params.duration || 2000, ranges: { filter: generateRGBChannelFilters(params.channelSeparation, params.glitchIntensity), transform: [{key:'transform',val:'translateX(0px)',prog:0}, {key:'transform',val:`translateX(${params.channelSeparation*15}px)`,prog:0.25}, {key:'transform',val:`translateX(-${params.channelSeparation*10}px)`,prog:0.5}, {key:'transform',val:'translateX(0px)',prog:0.75}, {key:'transform',val:`translateY(-${params.channelSeparation*5}px) rotate(-2deg)`,prog:0.85}, {key:'transform',val:'translateX(0px) translateY(0px) rotate(0deg)',prog:1}], backgroundImage: params.scanlineOpacity > 0 ? [{key:'backgroundImage',val:`linear-gradient(transparent 50%, rgba(0,0,0,${params.scanlineOpacity}) 50%)`,prog:0}, {key:'backgroundImage',val:`linear-gradient(transparent 50%, rgba(0,0,0,${params.scanlineOpacity}) 50%)`,prog:1}] : [] } }] }. Input schema: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), channelSeparation: z.number().min(0).max(2).default(1), glitchIntensity: z.number().min(0).max(100).default(50), scanlineOpacity: z.number().min(0).max(0.3).default(0.1), duration: z.number().optional() }). PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' }.

prompts.prompt: Design an internal effect preset called 'QuantizedDisplace' that creates a digital quantization effect where displacement happens in discrete, grid-aligned steps rather than smooth transitions. The effect should divide the animation timeline into 8 quantized 'blocks' where transforms snap between values instantly (using duplicate keyframes with same prog values for instant transitions). Each block should randomly select from a preset list of displacement states: translate(0,0), translate(32px,0), translate(-32px,0), translate(0,24px), translate(0,-24px), translate(32px,24px), etc. Combine this with a pixelation effect using image-rendering: pixelated and scaling transforms that snap between 0.95 and 1.05. Add a digital noise overlay using grayscale() and contrast() filters that toggle between states. Parameters include gridSize (determines displacement snap distances), quantizationSteps (number of discrete states), and pixelationAmount. The effect should feel like low-resolution digital compression artifacts.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic (AnimationRange[]). Return structure: { effects: [{ type: 'generic', mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, start: 0, duration: params.duration || 1600, easing: 'linear', ranges: { transform: generateQuantizedTransforms(params.gridSize, params.quantizationSteps), scale: generatePixelatedScale(params.pixelationAmount), filter: [{key:'filter',val:'grayscale(0%) contrast(100%)',prog:0}, {key:'filter',val:'grayscale(0%) contrast(100%)',prog:0.124}, {key:'filter',val:'grayscale(20%) contrast(110%)',prog:0.125}, {key:'filter',val:'grayscale(20%) contrast(110%)',prog:0.249}, {key:'filter',val:'grayscale(0%) contrast(90%)',prog:0.25}, {key:'filter',val:'grayscale(0%) contrast(90%)',prog:0.374}, {key:'filter',val:'grayscale(10%) contrast(105%)',prog:0.375}], imageRendering: [{key:'imageRendering',val:'pixelated',prog:0}, {key:'imageRendering',val:'pixelated',prog:1}] } }] }. Input schema: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), gridSize: z.number().min(8).max(64).default(32), quantizationSteps: z.number().min(4).max(16).default(8), pixelationAmount: z.number().min(0).max(0.2).default(0.05), duration: z.number().optional() }). Quantized transforms use duplicate prog values for instant snapping. PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' }.

prompts.prompt: Create an internal combined effect preset named 'TemporalPixelSort' that simulates time-based pixel sorting where past 'frames' create displacement trails. The effect should layer multiple displacement effects with different timing offsets to create a temporal echo. Generate 4 effect layers: Layer 1 (current frame) has no displacement, Layer 2 (1 frame behind) displaces translateX by 8px with 0.8 opacity, Layer 3 (2 frames behind) displaces translateX by 16px and translateY by -4px with 0.6 opacity, Layer 4 (3 frames behind) displaces translateX by 24px and translateY by -8px with 0.4 opacity. Each layer should also apply increasing blur (0px, 0.5px, 1px, 1.5px). The displacement direction should rotate through cardinal directions based on a direction parameter. Include a 'feedback' mode where displacements accumulate rather than reset. Parameters: trailLength (number of echo layers), decayRate (opacity reduction per layer), displacementVector (x,y multipliers), and feedbackMode (boolean).
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Combined (multiple generic effects with timing offsets). Return structure: { effects: Array.from({length: params.trailLength}, (_, i) => ({ type: 'generic', mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, start: i * 50, duration: params.duration - (i * 50), ranges: { transform: [{key:'transform',val:'translate(0,0)',prog:0}, {key:'transform',val:`translate(${params.displacementVector.x * (i+1) * 8}px, ${params.displacementVector.y * (i+1) * 4}px)`,prog:0.3}, {key:'transform',val:`translate(${params.displacementVector.x * (i+1) * 8}px, ${params.displacementVector.y * (i+1) * 4}px)`,prog:0.7}, {key:'transform',val:params.feedbackMode ? `translate(${params.displacementVector.x * (i+1) * 8}px, ${params.displacementVector.y * (i+1) * 4}px)` : 'translate(0,0)',prog:1}], opacity: [{key:'opacity',val:1,prog:0}, {key:'opacity',val:Math.max(0.2, 1 - (i * params.decayRate)),prog:0.1}, {key:'opacity',val:Math.max(0.2, 1 - (i * params.decayRate)),prog:1}], filter: [{key:'filter',val:`blur(${i * 0.5}px)`,prog:0}, {key:'filter',val:`blur(${i * 0.5}px)`,prog:1}] } })) }. Input schema: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), trailLength: z.number().min(2).max(8).default(4), decayRate: z.number().min(0.1).max(0.4).default(0.2), displacementVector: z.object({ x: z.number().min(-2).max(2).default(1), y: z.number().min(-2).max(2).default(-0.5) }), feedbackMode: z.boolean().default(false), duration: z.number().default(2000) }). PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' }.

prompts.prompt: Develop an internal waveform effect preset called 'GlitchSortReactive' that combines audio-reactive displacement with glitch-style pixel sorting aesthetics. The effect should use bass frequencies to trigger 'sort events' where content suddenly shifts into displaced blocks. Configure primary waveform effect with 'shake' type responding to bass (20-250Hz) with high threshold (0.7) so it only triggers on strong beats. When triggered, apply random X/Y displacement between -30 and 30 pixels. Add a secondary effect using 'exposure' type tied to treble frequencies that creates bright flashes (exposure 0.8 to 1.5) on high-frequency hits. Include a tertiary 'blur' effect tied to overall waveform amplitude that adds motion blur (0 to 3px) during intense sections. Parameters should include glitchSensitivity (multiplies all audio sensitivities), displacementChaos (randomization factor for shake), and flashIntensity (controls exposure range). The effect should feel like corrupted data responding to music.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Waveform (multi-effect audio-reactive). Return structure: { effects: [{ type: 'waveform', mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, effectType: 'shake', audioProperty: 'bass', sensitivity: 0.8 * params.glitchSensitivity, threshold: 0.7, shakeIntensity: params.displacementChaos, shakeSpeed: 15, axis: 'both' }, { type: 'waveform', mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, effectType: 'exposure', audioProperty: 'treble', sensitivity: 0.6 * params.glitchSensitivity, threshold: 0.5, minValue: 0.8, maxValue: 0.8 + (0.7 * params.flashIntensity) }, { type: 'waveform', mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, effectType: 'blur', audioProperty: 'waveform', sensitivity: 0.5 * params.glitchSensitivity, threshold: 0.4, minValue: 0, maxValue: 3 }] }. Input schema: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), glitchSensitivity: z.number().min(0.1).max(2).default(1), displacementChaos: z.number().min(10).max(50).default(30), flashIntensity: z.number().min(0).max(1).default(0.7) }). PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects', dependencies: { presets: [] } }.

prompts.prompt: Build an internal effect preset named 'MatrixPixelRain' that creates a cascading pixel displacement effect reminiscent of digital rain, where blocks of content appear to 'fall' and reorganize. Use generic AnimationRange to orchestrate a complex sequence: Start with the content intact (prog 0-0.1), then begin vertical displacement where different 'columns' start falling at staggered times using translateY (0px to 100px over prog 0.1-0.4), add horizontal jitter using translateX (random -5px to 5px oscillations from prog 0.2-0.6), introduce a 'matrix' color effect using filter: hue-rotate() cycling through 0deg to 120deg (green tint), and finally reassemble with reversed displacement (prog 0.6-1.0). Include opacity 'flickers' that create a digital rain trail effect (opacity drops to 0.3 then back to 1.0 at random intervals). Parameters: columnCount (divides effect into vertical segments), fallSpeed (controls translateY distance), matrixColor (degrees of hue rotation), and reassembleSmooth (boolean for smooth vs snapped reassembly).
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic (AnimationRange[]). Return structure: { effects: [{ type: 'generic', mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, start: 0, duration: params.duration || 2500, ranges: { transform: generateMatrixRainTransforms(params.columnCount, params.fallSpeed, params.reassembleSmooth), opacity: [{key:'opacity',val:1,prog:0}, {key:'opacity',val:1,prog:0.1}, {key:'opacity',val:0.3,prog:0.15}, {key:'opacity',val:1,prog:0.2}, {key:'opacity',val:0.5,prog:0.35}, {key:'opacity',val:1,prog:0.4}, {key:'opacity',val:0.3,prog:0.55}, {key:'opacity',val:1,prog:0.6}, {key:'opacity',val:1,prog:1}], filter: [{key:'filter',val:'hue-rotate(0deg) brightness(100%)',prog:0}, {key:'filter',val:'hue-rotate(0deg) brightness(100%)',prog:0.1}, {key:'filter',val:`hue-rotate(${params.matrixColor}deg) brightness(110%)`,prog:0.3}, {key:'filter',val:`hue-rotate(${params.matrixColor}deg) brightness(120%)`,prog:0.5}, {key:'filter',val:'hue-rotate(0deg) brightness(100%)',prog:0.8}, {key:'filter',val:'hue-rotate(0deg) brightness(100%)',prog:1}], backgroundImage: [{key:'backgroundImage',val:'linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0%, transparent 100%)',prog:0}, {key:'backgroundImage',val:'linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0,255,0,0.1) 0%, transparent 50%)',prog:0.2}, {key:'backgroundImage',val:'linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0,255,0,0.05) 0%, transparent 80%)',prog:0.7}, {key:'backgroundImage',val:'linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0%, transparent 100%)',prog:1}] } }] }. Input schema: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), columnCount: z.number().min(3).max(20).default(8), fallSpeed: z.number().min(50).max(300).default(100), matrixColor: z.number().min(0).max(360).default(120), reassembleSmooth: z.boolean().default(false), duration: z.number().optional() }). PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' }.
